headline: Apollo Sindoori Hotels submits AGM scrutinizer report
hook: Annual meeting results filed for Apollo Sindoori
summary: Apollo Sindoori Hotels Limited has officially filed the scrutinizer's report following its Annual General Meeting held on September 28, 2026. This filing confirms the voting results and procedural outcomes of the meeting. The report is a standard regulatory requirement for listed companies post-AGM.
why_it_matters: Procedural filing with no immediate impact on share price.
